descriptions.d21b_camera_oscillate_800a439c: Camera oscillation step: on first use set static vector A (0x80438544) to zero, vector B (0x80438550) to (0, 0, -450) and vector C (0x8043855c) to zero, each behind its own init flag; set B.y = (sin(tick * 0.0004) + 1) * 400 and C.z = (sin(tick * 0.0002) + 1) * 500, call the context camera's (+48) virtual slots 11 with B and 12 with C, run the logic hook 0x800c88c4 on the global hook object when present, and return 0.
